t0.date_reporting_rule: 2026-11-09 is the change day. Exclude it from complete-date before/after windows. Do not label its pre-T0 portion as a full pre day or post-T0 portion as a full post day.

google_search_console.standard_daily_date_basis: Pacific Time / America/Los_Angeles; retain provider-native literal dates and confirm manifest for the actual export
google_search_console.do_not: Do not transform exported date labels into Santiago dates, split daily aggregate rows by assumed hourly traffic, or mix daily timezones. Source completeness/finality is unknown until export.

bing.required_evidence: Timezone/date definition, exact property and final complete day from real Bing export or authorized interface. Apply T0 in that source basis only after those facts are known.

analytics_and_conversions.rule: Use existing property's timezone; distinguish timestamped events from date aggregates. Do not adopt host timezone.

existing_guard_compatibility.source: scripts/seo_measurement.py compare constructs adjacent current and previous date windows; seo_scope.py wraps it with scope proof
existing_guard_compatibility.guard_requirement: 60 consecutive complete source dates for adjacent 30-vs-30; 180 for adjacent 90-vs-90. Keep unchanged.
existing_guard_compatibility.t0_gap_conflict: Pre/post candidates above exclude change day, so they are not adjacent. Feeding them directly to existing compare would include change day or fail missing coverage; do not bypass completeness guard or fabricate that day.
existing_guard_compatibility.current_action: Record both planned windows separately with null results. Reuse import-performance, segment and bind-daily for real data. When coverage exists, review an explicit change-day-aware comparison path before computing the publication delta; do not present the generic adjacent-window output as T0 attribution. No importer rebuild is needed in this run.

ia_protocol_v2.design: 12 prompts x 5 consumer surfaces x 3 distinct dates
ia_protocol_v2.offset_origin: first legitimate valid consumer-interface access, not publication T0
ia_protocol_v2.t0_checkpoint_use: Review access and evidence status at publication T+7/14/28; do not silently rewrite the v2 plan's origin or execute blocked slots.
ia_protocol_v2.restrictions: No brand in prompts, no project-fiche scoring, no generation API substitute, no AI Lab generation, no claim from one isolated output.

null_policy.note: Calendar candidate counts are not actual data coverage. Lack of source access/export yields unknown, not zero.

source_zone_application: Calendar candidates are in Santiago only. Use native GSC daily dates unchanged (standard PT, verify actual export). Bing/Analytics dates and boundary derivation stay unbound until native timezone is documented. Do not infer source completeness from Santiago midnight.
